meta.title: Order Submission (Market & Limit)
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement market and limit order submission to Lighter.xyz so users can execute trades.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Market order submission: transaction signed, POST /sendTx, order ID returned
Limit order submission: with specified price, order ID returned
Order rejection errors handled (LighterOrderRejectError with context)
Amount convention: positive = buy, negative = sell

key-tasks.task: Implement rate limiting (token bucket: 600 req/min, 20 orders/sec/symbol)

architecture-context.pattern: Token bucket algorithm at adapter level Limits: 600 requests/minute REST, 20 orders/second per symbol Warning logged at 80% capacity

technical-specifications.spec:
async def submit_order( self, asset: Asset, amount: Decimal, order_type: str, limit_price: Decimal | None = None, stop_price: Decimal | None = None, ) -> str: await self._check_request_rate_limit() await self._check_order_rate_limit(asset.symbol)
side = "buy" if amount > 0 else "sell" quantity = abs(amount)
if order_type == "market": tx = self._create_market_order_tx(asset.symbol, side, quantity) elif order_type == "limit": tx = self._create_limit_order_tx(asset.symbol, side, quantity, limit_price)
signed_tx = self._sign_transaction(tx)
response = await self._client.post("/sendTx", json=signed_tx) response.raise_for_status() return response.json().get("order_id")
